design.evidence: every LOAD of one pointer-sized field of an accepted record is merged (Evidence::absorb, the replay of Evidence::record) and held to accepts_record: already TYPE_PTR, not type-locked, no phi/index/integer use, 2+ offsets incl. 0, < MAX_FIELD_OFFSET, not an array run; pruned and made dense like a parameter
design.same_record: the loaded record's claims are a subset of the enclosing record's (offset, width, type spelling) with its unclaimed bytes laid out alike (ledger::keeps_unclaimed); checked after the standalone rules so one coincident word never counts (obstack/_obstack_newchunk)
design.self_mint: ledger::mint completes the structure around its incomplete shell (a completed struct is a fresh Rc); the self field is keyed SELF so self-pointing layouts of one shape dedupe; SynthRequest with a self or nested field has no recipe (non-portable) so --jobs names it in its one ordered worker
design.shell_resolution: kuna_structsynth::resolve_self_pointer: a LOAD/STORE value type that is a pointer to a synthesized record's own shell takes the pointer to the completed record (infertypes propagate_load_store, casts get_output_token_load/get_input_cast_store); DWARF shells untouched
design.depth: MAX_NEST_DEPTH = 2 records below the parameter; only the immediately enclosing record is compared for self-reference

known_limits: A loaded value the lattice types as an integer declines however it is dereferenced; that is most dereferenced field loads (see relaxations_measured_not_shipped).
Only the immediately enclosing record is compared for self-reference; a record reached through two links (A->B->A) gets a second name.
A record whose types only nearly agree with its holder (a one-level unrolling reads the inner links as unsigned long) is nested as a record of its own: correct offsets, a second name.
Under nest the convergence sweep can mint: a redone reader's outer layout names the surviving inner record.
A request with a nested or self field is non-portable, so a --jobs run names it in its one ordered worker (correct, serial for those functions).
A loop-carried pointer chase (n = n->next) reaches a phi and declines, as a parameter walk does.
